newsitem.title: ESTONIA: LEKS COLLECTS 20.7 MLN IN Q1 PREMIUMS.
newsitem.headline: LEKS COLLECTS 20.7 MLN IN Q1 PREMIUMS.

text.p: Leks Insurance, which hopes to list its shares early summer, collected 20.7 million kroons in premiums during the first quarter versus 13 million kroons in the same period in 1996, the company said on Thursday.
Leks collected 7.66 million kroons during March, Aarne Orav, finance director, told Reuters.
Leks paid claims worth 4.8 million kroons during the first quarter and two million kroons in March, he added.
The insurance company was in profit in the first quarter, Orav said. The profit figure will be ready at the end of May.
Leks will start its share issue on April 21, to raise its capital by four million kroons to 42 million kroons.
Tallinna Pank owns 52 percent of Leks' shares.
